computers.pick_title: Make an existing prop a computer
computers.pick_hint: Aim at any monitor or laptop the game already has in the world and press Enter. Nothing is spawned: the prop standing there becomes this computer.
computers.picked_hint: A prop the game already has in the world, so it cannot be swapped or moved. Delete this computer to give the prop back.
computers.style_default_hint: No style of its own: it opens in the server's default, currently %s.
computers.name: Name
computers.jobs_empty: No jobs listed: anyone who walks up to it can sign in.
computers.jobs_hint: A job name as your framework spells it, and the lowest grade allowed. The server checks it on every action.
computers.boss_typing: No job is called %s. Keep typing, or pick one from the list.
computers.boss_unknown: This server has no job called %s yet. Nobody gets the Business Manager here until it does.
computers.boss_no_rank_hint: %s has no boss rank, so nobody would get the Business Manager here. Mark one of its grades as boss in your framework first.
computers.boss_off_hint: Nobody manages a job from this computer.
computers.boss_any_hint: Any boss who signs in here gets the Business Manager for their own job: staff, ranks, hiring and funds. Everyone else sees the usual apps.
computers.boss_any_locked_hint: A boss of a job listed under Access gets the Business Manager for their own job here: staff, ranks, hiring and funds. Everyone else sees the usual apps.
computers.boss_job_hint: The %s boss gets the Business Manager here: staff, ranks, hiring and funds. Everyone else sees the usual apps.
computers.boss_job_none: Choose the job whose boss manages from this computer.
computers.boss_locked_out: %s is not listed under Access, so its boss cannot open this computer.
computers.boss_unavailable_disabled: The Business Manager is switched off for the whole server (Enabled in configs/shared/boss.lua).
computers.boss_unavailable_framework: The Business Manager needs QBCore or Qbox, so it is not available on this server.
computers.manages_any: Business Manager for any boss, each for their own job
computers.aim_hint: Next you place it with the gizmo: it starts sitting on whatever you are looking at, so aim at the desk first.
computers.search: Search by name, id, prop, style or job
computers.none_placed: Nothing placed from the panel yet.
computers.delete_placed_body: All %s computers placed or picked from this panel go, and anyone using one is signed out. The computers in the config stay.
computers.remove_confirm: "%s" is taken away, and anyone using it is signed out. Its logs are kept until they expire.
computers.remove_config_confirm: "%s" stops being a computer, and anyone using it is signed out. It comes from the config, so it stays in this list and you can restore it at any time.
computers.removed_hint: Removed in this panel: nobody can use it until it is restored

camtool.title: Put up a camera
camtool.hint: What you see is what the camera will show.

pick.title: Pick a prop
pick.none: Aim at a monitor or laptop
pick.none_printer: Aim at a printer or copier

admin.subtitle: Every computer on the server, and the tool that places new ones
